description:
**Job Title:** 
 Azure DevOps Engineer (AI \& Automation)
 



  





**Location:** 
 Noida
 



  





**Experience:** 
 Min 3 Years
 




  





**Department:** 
 Engineering / Infrastructure \& Platform
 




  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to own our core DevOps administration while leading the
 



 implementation of AI\-driven development workflows. In this role, you will manage
 



 repositories, establish automated CI/CD pipelines, and design autonomous coding, testing,
 



 and code\-review agents using technologies like Claude Code, Anthropic Agent SDK, and
 



 GitHub Copilot Workspace/Agents. You will bridge classical platform engineering with AI
 



 native software development lifecycles.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. DevOps Administration \& Repository Management** 




**•** 
 Repository Architecture: Design, enforce, and maintain repository branching strategies
 



 (e.g., Trunk\-Based, GitFlow, Feature\-Branching) and access governance across
 



 organizations.
 



 • CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Build, optimize, and secure multi\-environment
 



 deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps with caching
 



 and automated quality gates.
 



 • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Provision and manage cloud resources using Terraform,
 



 Pulumi, or Bicep, ensuring zero\-drift environments.
 



 • DevSecOps Integration: Implement automated secret scanning (e.g., Gitleaks),
 



 dependency vulnerability checks (Trivy/Snyk), and SAST/DAST within CI steps.
 




  





**2\. AI Coding Agent Setup \& Branch Workflows** 




  





 • Coding Agent Deployment: Configure and orchestrate developer AI agents (e.g.,
 



 Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Cloud Agents, or custom agent frameworks) to perform
 



 autonomous task execution across different Git branches.
 



 • Repository Context \& Prompts: Author and maintain repository\-level context files
 



 (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, custom system prompts, and MCP server integrations) to
 



 steer agents toward project conventions and architecture patterns.
 



 • Multi\-Branch Automation: Configure workflow triggers that allow AI agents to pick up
 



 issue tickets, work within dedicated feature/bugfix branches, and automatically draft
 



 PRs.
 



  










**3\. Automated Code Review \& Testing Agents** 




  





 • Code Review Agents: Integrate automated AI code\-review agents within pull request
 



 workflows to perform compliance checks, security audits, and style adherence reviews
 



 before human sign\-off.
 



 • Automated Testing \& QA Agents: Build autonomous testing pipelines where agents
 



 analyze diffs, generate missing unit/integration tests, triage test failures, and suggest
 



 fixes directly in CI.
 



 • Governance \& Safeguards: Establish strict safety guardrails, execution sandboxes, and
 



 human\-in\-the\-loop approvals for agent\-generated code.
 



  





**Technical Qualifications** 




  





**Must\-Have Experience** 




  





 • Core DevOps (2\+ Years): Hands\-on expertise in CI/CD pipeline building, Docker,
 



 Kubernetes, and IaC (Terraform/Bicep/CloudFormation).
 



 • Git Administration: Mastery of Git internals, branch protection rules, merge strategies,
 



 and repository permissions.
 



 • AI Coding Tools \& SDKs: Proven experience configuring or extending GitHub Copilot
 



 (Copilot Workspace, Agent Mode, Custom Instructions/Skills) or Claude (Claude Code
 



 CLI, Anthropic API/SDK, Model Context Protocol).
 



 • Automation Languages: High proficiency in Python, Bash, or TypeScript/Node.js for
 



 building custom hooks, bots, and API integrations.
 



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Experience** 




  





 • Experience building multi\-agent orchestrations (e.g., CrewAI, LangChain, or custom
 



 sub\-agents).
 



 • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server setups to connect AI agents with
 



 internal tooling, databases, and monitoring systems.
 



 • Deep understanding of DevSecOps standards and cloud infrastructure cost
 



 optimization.
 








**Expected 90\-Day Deliverables** 




  





 Month 1: Audit existing repos and establish standardized CI/CD templates and branch
 



 protection rules across all development projects.
 



 Month 2: Deploy initial Claude / GitHub Copilot agent workflows for automated PR code
 



 reviews and unit test generation.
 



 Month 3: Fully operationalize an end\-to\-end agentic workflow where feature tickets can be
 



 assigned to branch\-specific coding agents to generate, test, and submit initial pull requests.

title: Migration Architect
description:
SourceFuse is looking for a Cloud Migration Architect to lead clients through AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) engagements end\-to\-end, from discovery and assessment through Landing Zone setup, multi\-account governance, workload migration, and modernization.
 



 You'll own the migration roadmap for enterprise clients while ensuring security, cost,
 



 and operational posture keep pace with delivery.
 



  





**Experience Required \- 8\+ Years** 




**Preferred Location \- Noida/Mohali** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Migration Strategy \& Execution:** 




 ●
 **MIGRATION DISCOVERY \& STRATEGY \-** 
 Lead AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) engagements — discovery, application portfolio assessment, and migration wave planning —
 



 to build a de\-risked, sequenced migration roadmap for enterprise clients.
 



 ●
 **WORKLOAD MIGRATION \& MODERNIZATION \-** 
 Execute migrations using AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), Database Migration Service (DMS) with Schema Conversion Tool (SCT),
 



 DataSync, and AWS Transform for AI\-assisted application and code modernization.
 



 ●
 **LANDING ZONE \& MULTI\-ACCOUNT ONBOARDING** 
 \- Stand up AWS Control Tower / Landing Zone (incl. Landing Zone Accelerator for HIPAA and other compliance\-driven environments), AWS
 



 Organizations, and Service Control Policies to onboard and govern client accounts.
 



**Governance, Security \& Optimization:** 




 ●
 **SECURITY \& COMPLIANCE** 
 \- Implement and manage security controls across IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, AWS WAF, and Network Firewall, ensuring migrated environments meet
 



 standards such as HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, and RBI where applicable.
 



 ●
 **COST OPTIMIZATION / FINOPS** 
 \- Analyze usage patterns and right\-size resources using Cost Explorer, Trusted Advisor, and Compute Optimizer; apply Reserved Instances / Savings Plans
 



 and cost allocation tagging to reduce spend across multi\-account environments.
 



 ●
 **INFRASTRUCTURE AS CODE, CI/CD \& DR** 
 \- Automate infrastructure provisioning with Terraform and CloudFormation, build CI/CD pipelines (CodePipeline/CodeBuild/CodeDeploy or Jenkins) for
 



 repeatable deployments, and design disaster recovery plans against defined RTO targets.
 



  





**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS:** 




**Migration \& Cloud Foundation \-** 




 ● Migration Tooling \- AWS Migration Hub, Application Migration Service (MGN), DMS, SCT, DataSync, AWS Transform
 



 ● Landing Zone \& Governance \- Control Tower, Landing Zone Accelerator, AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies
 



 ● Compute \& Orchestration \- EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, Elastic Beanstalk, Auto Scaling
 



 ● Storage \& Database \- S3, EBS, EFS, FSx, RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, DocumentDB
 



 ● Networking \- VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, PrivateLink, ELB, CloudFront
 



  





**Security, Data \& Operations \-** 




 ● Security \& Identity \- IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, WAF, Network Firewall, KMS, IAM Identity Center (SSO), Okta, Cognito (CIAM)
 



 ● Analytics \& Event\-Driven \- Athena, EMR, Redshift, EventBridge, SNS, SQS
 



 ● Observability \& Monitoring \- CloudWatch, X\-Ray, and third\-party APM (New Relic, Dynatrace, Prometheus, SigNoz)
 



 ● Infrastructure as Code \- Terraform and AWS CloudFormation — reusable modules, automated deployment workflows
 



 ● Systems Administration \- server administration, hardening, and troubleshooting
 



  





**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS** 




 ● AWS Certified Solutions Architect — Professional / Associate
 



 ● AWS Certified Advanced Networking — Specialty
 



 ● AWS Certified Advanced Security — Specialty
 



  





**BONUS POINTS** 




 ● CONTAINER PLATFORMS \- Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerized workloads.
 



 ● COMPLIANCE FRAMEWORKS \- Experience supporting HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, or RBI (banking) compliance requirements.
 



 ● EMERGING PRACTICES \- Exposure to FinOps, AIOps, AI\-assisted DevOps, MCP servers, or Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) leadership.
 



 ● MULTI\-CLOUD EXPOSURE \- Hands\-on migration experience moving workloads from Azure and/or GCP into AWS, plus rehosting on\-premises VMware vSphere/ESXi and Proxmox VE
 



 virtualized environments.
 



 ● GENAI ON AWS \- Exposure to Amazon Bedrock, Kendra, or Amazon Q for AI\-assisted client solutions.
 



 ● REGULATED INDUSTRY DELIVERY \- Proven delivery in Healthcare (HIPAA) and/or Banking \& Financial Services (RBI) environments.

description:
Title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Product Area Focus
   

  

 Location: Noida/ Bangalore (Hybrid)
   

  

**Summary Of Role**
 Own availability, the most important product feature, by continually striving for sustained operational excellence of Sumo’s planet\-scale observability and security products. Work alongside your global SRE team, executing on projects in your product\-area specific reliability roadmap, to optimize operations, increase efficiency in our use of cloud resources and our developer’s time, harden security posture, and increase feature velocity of our developers Work closely with multiple teams to optimize the operations of their microservices \- and improve the lives of the engineers within your product area engineering team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support the engineering teams within your product area by maintaining and executing a reliability roadmap of opportunities for improvement for reliability, maintainability, security, efficiency, and velocity \- and help for realizing those opportunities.
* Collaborate with development infrastructure, Global SRE, and your product area engineering teams to establish and continually refine your reliability roadmap.
* Participate in defining, evolving, and managing SLOs for several teams within your product area.
* Participate in on\-call rotations within your product area to understand operations workload so you can continually work to improve the on\-call experience and reduce operational workload for running microservices and related components.
* Complete projects to optimize and tune on\-call experience for your engineering teams.
* Continually improve the lifecycle of microservices and architectural components from inception and design, through deployment, operation, and refinement.
* Write code and automation to reduce operational workload, increase efficiency, improve security posture, eliminate toil, and enable Sumo’s developers to deliver features more rapidly.
* Work closely with the developer infrastructure teams to expedite development infrastructure adoption of tools to advance your reliability roadmap by identifying needs for your supported engineering teams, and contributing back features and bug fixes when needed.
* Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
* Facilitate blame\-free root cause analysis meetings for incidents to learn and drive improvement
* Participate in and continually improve our global IRC (incident response coordination) for all products.
* Drive root cause identification and issue resolution with the teams.
* Work inside of a fast\-paced iterative environment.
* Hire \& Mentor new team members.


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* Cloud native application development experience leveraging best practices and design patterns
* Strong debugging and trouble\-shooting skills across the entire technology stack
* Deep understanding of AWS Networking, Compute, Storage, and managed services.
* Competency with modern CI/CD tooling like Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible \& Jenkins
* Experience with full life cycle support of services, from creation to production support
* Versed in Infrastructure as Code practices using technologies like Terraform or Cloud Formation
* Ability to author production ready code in at least one the following: Java, Scala or Go.
* Experience with Linux systems and at home on the command line
* Understand and apply modern approaches to cloud\-native software security
* Experienced with agile frameworks, such as Scrum and Kanban, and how to operate within these frameworks to continually deliver value.
* Flexible and willing to step into new roles and responsibilities
* Willingness to learn and use Sumo Logic products for solving reliability and security issues
* Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or another scientific or technical discipline
* 8\+ years of professional experience in applied software security role


**Desirable Skills**
* Experience using Sumo Logic products or other observability products for reliability and security
* Experienced with planet scale product development
* Running and operating SaaS products on AWS Cloud with expert level proficiency
* Experience with streaming technologies like Kafka, Kafka Streams, or KSQL
* Expert level experience in one or more of: Java, Go, Scala, or Python
* Expert level experience in one or more of: Terraform, Jenkins, Kubernetes
* Extensive experience running and tuning JVM workloads at scale


**About Us**
 Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI\-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

title: Cloud Specialist
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
 We are looking for NOC Cloud Team lead who will have a unique blend of technical depth and leadership, where you will work on advanced private cloud infrastructures — spanning OpenStack administration, Linux systems management, and automation\-driven efficiencies — while also guiding a high\-performing team to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable cloud solutions. Beyond technical delivery, you will be expected to build strong customer relationships and uphold operational excellence, making this an ideal opportunity for someone who leads with both expertise and accountability.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Carry out OpenStack cloud administration, including performance tuning, troubleshooting, resource optimisation, availability zone configuration, tenant management, and host aggregation.
* Install, configure, monitor, and optimise Linux systems, both physical and virtual, including kernel tuning, LVM management, and the implementation of advanced security measures.
* Manage and maintain RHEL, Ubuntu, and CentOS operating systems, ensuring smooth upgrade processes.
* Configure and troubleshoot networking protocols and services, including TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, VXLAN, routing, DNS, DHCP, bridging, and IP Tables.
* Operate hardware management interfaces such as iLO, iDRAC, and CIMC efficiently.
* Perform CEPH storage management activities, including OSD operations and cluster flag adjustments.
* Leverage automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet, and Terraform for provisioning and configuration management.
* Develop automation scripts using Bash and Python to improve operational efficiency and service quality.
* Deploy and manage containerised applications using Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes.
* Ensure compliance with SLAs, ITSM guidelines, operational processes, and industry best practices.
* Work closely with stakeholders to deliver tailored cloud solutions and maintain strong client relationships.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to team members.
* Drive continuous improvement across cloud operations, automation, service reliability, and customer delivery.


**You will bring**
* At least 9 years of professional experience in private cloud technologies, particularly OpenStack and Linux administration.
* Experience in a combined technical and team leadership role.
* Red Hat OpenStack certification, along with RHCSA and RHCE certifications.
* Strong Linux administration expertise, including operating system optimisation, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in automation scripting using Bash and Python.
* Hands\-on experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet, and Terraform.
* Working knowledge of SDN, NFV concepts, and microservices or container orchestration platforms.
* Advanced networking knowledge, including network configuration, troubleshooting, performance optimisation, and fault resolution.
* Experience managing hardware interfaces across enterprise systems, including iLO, iDRAC, and CIMC.
* Operational expertise in CEPH storage management.
* Strong understanding of OpenStack components, architecture, resource management, and troubleshooting.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build strong customer engagement.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities.

title: Systems Integration Specialist Advisor
description:
**Req ID:** 
 387346
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Specialist Advisor to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

 8\+ years of experience
   

  

**Job Description**
 The File \& Object Storage Engineering team delivers scalable, secure, and automated file and object storage platforms supporting enterprise application onboarding, data center builds, and rapid data growth across lines of business.
   

  

 The File and Object senior infrastructure engineer is tasked with the design, configuration, and ongoing engineering of the organization’s file storage platforms. This role requires the engineer to collaborate with application teams, assisting them in onboarding their applications to utilize file and object storage solutions. Additionally, the engineer provides support with data migrations and engages closely with vendors to facilitate enhancements and resolve technical issues.
   

  

 One of the key responsibilities of the engineer is to identify and implement automation opportunities that streamline daily activities. This includes provisioning, data migrations, and addressing security remediation asks. The engineer also serves as an escalation point for the operations team, providing expertise and guidance for complex issues.
   

  

 Key scope includes:
   

  

* Deliver end‑to‑end provisioning (file shares and object buckets) aligned to SLA targets and enterprise demand
* Support large‑scale onboarding, data migrations, and capacity expansion for new data centers and platforms
* Drive adoption of automation (API) to reduce manual workflows and improve TAT
* Enable standardized, policy‑driven provisioning and improve accuracy, governance, and reporting
* Support platform stability by resolving complex issues and acting as escalation point for provisioning and platform incidents
* Partner with architecture, security, and platform teams to support enhancements, certification, and long‑term platform evolution
* Contribute to improving customer experience by enabling self‑service, reducing rework, and simplifying workflows


 This role is critical to sustaining provisioning throughput, enabling data center expansion, and accelerating the shift toward automation‑first, API‑driven storage delivery.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 
+ 4–6 years of infrastructure or storage engineering experience
+ Experience supporting enterprise file and/or object storage platforms
+ Strong troubleshooting and operational support skills
+ Experience working in SLA‑driven environments


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 
+ Hands‑on experience with file and object storage provisioning and support
+ Experience managing provisioning requests, onboarding, and data migrations
+ Understanding of storage lifecycle (capacity, performance, lifecycle mgmt.)
+ Experience with scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, Ansible)
+ Knowledge of OS (Linux/Windows) and networking fundamentals
+ Ability to handle L2/L3 escalation and drive issue resolution
+ Experience working with cross‑functional teams (app, infra, vendors)
+ Focus on improving TAT, reducing manual effort, and standardizing workflows


**Desired Qualifications**
* 
+ Experience with NetApp ONTAP and enterprise object storage platforms
+ Exposure to self‑service provisioning (IDP), APIs, and automation at scale
+ Familiarity with cloud storage platforms and container environments
+ Understanding of security, compliance, and governance in storage
+ Ability to contribute to automation improvements and operational initiatives
